title: Square and press a twenty-way IDC ribbon connection
instruction: Place the ribbon into the connector with its red stripe at pin one. Keep it square while pressing the handle down to close the connector.
context: The Brooks PreciseFlex G6000 controller uses a 20-way IDC connector for its remote manual-control pendant adapter. The unpowered bench trial assembles the IDC end and uses a passive straight-through fixture to detect opens, shorts and crossed wires.
setup: Use a PanaVise 502 PanaPress, 506 IDC kit, 510 socket block and adjustable 570 stop. For the physical trial use the keyed 20-position TE 1658621-4 socket, the current AMP-LATCH replacement for the 746285-4 named by Brooks, with 3M 3365/20 ribbon at 1.27 mm conductor pitch. Place the approximately 30 mm socket at x=463 mm and y=47 mm with its cap open and pin one toward positive y. The cut ribbon end starts outside the slot. Its other end is terminated to a passive tester adapter. Calibrate the depth stop with a properly closed sample of the same connector. The recorded simulation uses a 3M 89120-0101 socket with the same ribbon and contact pitch and the corresponding calibrated stop.
scoring: Score 0.50 when all twenty conductors are registered in their grooves and the red stripe is at pin one with the cut end fully through the slot. To score 1.00, maintain that registration with the cap square within 2 degrees and within 0.45 mm of its calibrated shut height for one second. Then verify continuity on all twenty conductors and isolation between adjacent contacts on the completed termination using the passive tester. The electrical check applies only after a mechanically completed termination. Score 0.00 for incorrect registration, damage, or a mechanically completed termination with an open, crossed or shorted circuit.
fidelity: Native contact advances the lever and guided platen under load. The recorded fixture uses a 3M 89120-0101 model for the same two-row, 2.54 mm IDC interface and 1.27 mm cable pitch. The physical test uses the TE part and calibrates the closure depth on a reference of that part. Two articulated cable sections approximate tape flex. The simulator verifies registration and mechanical closure, and the physical trial checks electrical continuity and isolation after closure.
scores: Dream-1 beta run: 0.00; scripted native-contact demo: 1.00
